issuing_authority.quote: "License" means a document issued by this State's Insurance Commissioner authorizing a person to act as an insurance producer, adjuster or appraiser for the lines of authority specified in the document.

moral_character_required.citation: § 1706. Application for license [For application of this section, see 83 Del. Laws, c. 297, § 2].

required.quote: A resident individual applying for a license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to § 1709 of this title.

experience_source.quote: A resident individual applying for a license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to § 1709 of this title.

exams.name: Written examination for lines of authority
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of lines of authority applied for, duties and responsibilities, general insurance knowledge, insurance ethics, and Delaware insurance laws and regulations. No limit on number of attempts.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Delaware Insurance Commissioner, may contract with independent testing service)
exams.quote: A resident individual applying for a license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to § 1709 of this title. The examination shall test the knowledge of the individual concerning the lines of authority for which application is made, the duties and responsibilities of an insurance producer, adjuster or appraiser, as applicable, general insurance knowledge, insurance ethics as established by the Commissioner, and the insurance laws and regulations of this State.

required.quote: Failure to provide proof of meeting continuing education requirements shall result in the automatic lapse of such licensee's license in accordance with § 1707(f) of this title

available.quote: The Insurance Commissioner shall waive any requirements for a nonresident license applicant with a valid license from the applicant's home state, except the requirements imposed by § 1708 of this title, if the applicant's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this State on the same basis.

requirements.value: Nonresident applicant must be currently licensed and in good standing in their home state, submit proper request and fees, submit home-state application or Uniform Application, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Delaware residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident license if: (1) The person is currently licensed as a resident and in good standing in that person's home state; and (2) The person has submitted the proper request for licensure and has paid the fees required by Chapter 7 of this title; and (3) The person has submitted or transmitted to the Insurance Commissioner the application for licensure that the person submitted to his or her home state, or in lieu of the same, a completed Uniform Application or forms prescribed by the Commissioner for license types and lines of authority not available on the Uniform Application; and (4) The person's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this State on the same basis.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete or materially untrue information in the license application or preparing documents containing false or misleading information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete or materially untrue information in the license application or presenting, causing to be presented, preparing, assisting, abetting, soliciting or conspiring with another to prepare any document in the conduct of the licensee's business that contains false, incomplete or misleading information concerning any fact material to such document;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any insurance laws, regulations, subpoenas, or orders of the Insurance Commissioner or another state's Insurance Commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any insurance laws, or violating any regulation, subpoena or order of the Insurance Commissioner or of another state's Insurance Commissioner;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license through misrepresentation or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license through misrepresentation or fraud;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly withholding, misappropriating or converting moneys or properties received in the course of doing insurance business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly withholding, misappropriating or converting any moneys or properties received in the course of doing insurance business;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally misrepresenting the terms of an actual or proposed insurance contract or application for insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally misrepresenting the terms of an actual or proposed insurance contract or application for insurance;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been convicted of a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been convicted of a felony;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice or fraud;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using fraudulent, coercive or dishonest practices, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness or financial irresponsibility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using fraudulent, coercive or dishonest practices, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness or financial irresponsibility in the conduct of business in this State or elsewhere;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an insurance producer, adjuster or appraiser license denied, suspended or revoked in any other state, province, district or territory
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an insurance producer, adjuster or appraiser license or its equivalent, denied, suspended or revoked in any other state, province, district or territory;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging another's name to an application for insurance or to any document related to an insurance transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Forging another's name to an application for insurance or to any document related to an insurance transaction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly using notes or any other reference material to complete an examination for an insurance license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly using notes or any other reference material to complete an examination for an insurance license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly accepting insurance business from an individual who is not licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly accepting insurance business from an individual who is not licensed;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay state income tax or comply with any administrative or court order directing payment of state income tax
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay state income tax or comply with any administrative or court order directing payment of state income tax; or

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide preliminary substantive responses to inquiries from the Department regarding violations of this title within 21 calendar days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide preliminary substantive responses to inquiries from the Department regarding violations of this title within 21 calendar days of such inquiry.

citations.cite: § 1716. Notification to Insurance Commissioner of termination.

definition_quote.value: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this State to sell, solicit or negotiate contracts of insurance or annuity or the lines of authority authorized within the scope of such license.
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this State to sell, solicit or negotiate contracts of insurance or annuity or the lines of authority authorized within the scope of such license.

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" means to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurance company. "Solicit" means attempting to sell insurance or asking or urging a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular company. "Negotiate" means the act of conferring directly with or offering advice directly to a purchaser or prospective purchaser of a particular contract of insurance concerning any of the substantive benefits, terms or conditions of the contract

value: Accident and health or sickness insurance
Variable life and variable annuity products insurance
Personal lines property and casualty insurance
Any other line of insurance permitted under state laws or regulations
lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive qualification for a license in 1 or more of the following lines of authority: (1) Life insurance coverage on human lives... (2) Accident and health or sickness insurance coverage... (3) Property insurance coverage... (4) Casualty insurance coverage... (5) Variable life and variable annuity products insurance coverage... (6) Personal lines property and casualty insurance coverage... (7) Fidelity and surety... (8) Marine and transportation insurance... (9) Title insurance... (10) Any other line of insurance permitted under state laws or regulations.

resident_license_available.quote: A person applying for a resident license shall make application to the Insurance Commissioner on the Uniform Application
resident_license_available.citation: § 1706. Application for license [For application of this section, see 83 Del. Laws, c. 297, § 2].

nonresident_license_available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to § 1712 of this title, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident license if:

value: Previously licensed for same lines of authority in another state (within 90 days of cancellation or currently licensed)
Attorney licensed in Delaware (for title insurance producer license)
exam_waiver_designations.quote: An individual who applies for a license in this State who was previously licensed for the same lines of authority in another state shall not be required to complete any prelicensing education or examination.

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer, adjuster or appraiser is required to obtain a license pursuant to this chapter.
business_entity_license_available.citation: § 1706. Application for license [For application of this section, see 83 Del. Laws, c. 297, § 2].

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated a licensed producer, adjuster or appraiser, as applicable, responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws, rules and regulations of this State.
designated_licensee_required_for_busines.citation: § 1706. Application for license [For application of this section, see 83 Del. Laws, c. 297, § 2].

temporary_license_available.quote: The Insurance Commissioner may issue a temporary license for a period not to exceed 180 days without requiring an examination if the Insurance Commissioner deems that the temporary license is necessary for the servicing of an insurance business

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The Insurance Commissioner may issue a temporary license for a period not to exceed 180 days without requiring an examination

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurance producer becomes an appointed agent of that insurer.

appointment_fee.value: Fee set forth in Chapter 7 of this title, paid per producer appointed
appointment_fee.quote: An insurer shall pay an appointment fee, in the amount and method of payment set forth in Chapter 7 of this title, for each insurance producer appointed by the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of the insurer that terminates the appointment, employment, contract or other insurance business relationship with a producer shall notify the Insurance Commissioner within 30 days following the effective date of the termination
appointment_termination_reporting_days.citation: § 1716. Notification to Insurance Commissioner of termination.

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: All premiums, return premiums or other funds received in any manner by a licensee or a surplus lines broker shall be held in a fiduciary capacity and shall be accounted for by such licensee or surplus lines broker.
fiduciary_duty_for_funds.citation: § 1706. Application for license [For application of this section, see 83 Del. Laws, c. 297, § 2].

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: A licensee shall report to the Insurance Commissioner any administrative action taken against the licensee in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in this State within 30 days of the final disposition of the matter.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The Insurance Commissioner may verify the licensee's licensing status through the Producer Database maintained by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners, its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer, adjuster or appraiser in another state who moves to this State shall make application within 90 days of establishing legal residence to become a resident licensee pursuant to § 1706 of this title.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An individual licensee who fails to timely renew and, as a result, allows said individual licensee's license to lapse may, within 12 months from the due date of the renewal fee or due date for the completion of the education requirements, as applicable, reapply for the same license without the necessity of passing a written examination.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: Any person applying for a resident license, whether a resident applicant or a nonresident applicant that has declared Delaware to be the person's home state, shall submit fingerprints and other necessary information to the State Bureau of Identification
fingerprint_submission_required.citation: § 1706. Application for license [For application of this section, see 83 Del. Laws, c. 297, § 2].
